Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_CreateMode_:
Deed required: safehouses are created with a deed, and the deed tier sets the size.
Free: no deed needed; the size is limited by Free mode max area and Free mode outline limit.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_FreeMaxSide: In free mode, the outline of the whole safehouse (the rectangle around all its pieces) can be at most this many tiles wide and long. Area is the main limit; this only stops long, thin shapes.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_FreeMaxArea: Largest area of a safehouse in free mode, in tiles. It never exceeds the outline limit squared.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_ClaimGap_to:
Minimum number of tiles between safehouses of different players; owners in the same faction use "Gap to faction safehouses" instead. Safehouses of the same owner can touch but not overlap.
Resource checks also look this many tiles beyond the area.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_FactionClai: Minimum number of tiles between your safehouse and safehouses whose owner is in your faction. 0 lets them touch, but they can never overlap. Uses the faction you are in when you create or redraw.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_MaxPieces_t:
How many rectangles one safehouse can be made of, for L, U and other shapes. Keeping 4 is recommended. Each piece is a separate safehouse in the game, so raising this:
1. Makes the safehouse data players download when they join bigger, and uses up the server-wide member list capacity faster (each piece counts separately); once it is full, no one can create or share safehouses.
2. Can make the game stutter briefly each time a player changes a complex shape while marking the area.
3. Makes it more likely that a removed member lands in another piece of the same safehouse and is only moved out at the game's next check (up to about 20 seconds each time).
Lowering it only affects new safehouses and redraws; existing safehouses stay as they are.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_MaxShares_t: How many named players an owner can share one safehouse with.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_AllowFactio: When enabled, owners can share a safehouse with their own faction.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_LapseKeepDa: When a rental expires and a safehouse lapses, its area is kept for this many days and no one else can create a safehouse there. Renewing the rental restores it; after that, the area is released.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_IdleDays_to:
A safehouse is released when nobody on its list (the owner, players it is shared with, and faction members it is shared with) has stepped into its area for this many days. Applies to free safehouses and to those not kept by a paid slot. Release works like abandoning: the deed is not returned. Safehouses kept by a rented slot follow their lease instead.
0 = never (safehouses kept by a bought slot are not released either).
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_IdleBuyDays:
A safehouse kept by a bought (permanent) slot is released when nobody on its list (the owner, players it is shared with, and faction members it is shared with) has stepped into its area for this many days; the deed is not returned. Safehouses kept by a rented slot follow their lease instead. If this is not longer than the free limit (IdleDays), the free limit applies.
0 = never.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_IdleInsure_: Owners can pay to protect a safehouse from idle release for as many days as they choose. While insured it counts as visited; when the insurance ends, the countdown starts again from the full limit. Rented-slot safehouses don't need it (their lease decides). Needs the Minidoracat Economy mod. Set the daily price for each deed tier on the Paid slots tab of the safehouse admin panel.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RedrawMinut:
For this many minutes after creation, the owner can redraw the area. No deed is used or returned.
0 turns redrawing off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RedrawLimit: How many times the owner can redraw a safehouse within the redraw time limit after creating it. Redrawing does not use a deed.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RangesFacti: With "Show ranges on the ground" on, players also see safehouses whose owner is in their faction. Their own safehouses and those shared with them are always shown.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RangesOther: With "Show ranges on the ground" on, players also see every other player's safehouse (not their own, not shared with them, not their faction's). This only changes what is drawn: the game already sends every safehouse's area to all players.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_StorageMode: Members can search the containers in a safehouse from the manager window. "Guide only" shows an arrow to the container. "Remote take" lets members with the Remote take permission, standing inside the safehouse, take items straight into their inventory; it takes the normal transfer time and they have to stand still. "Off" hides [Find items].
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_AvoidRoads_: A safehouse area cannot include roads.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RoadMargin_: No road may be within this many tiles outside the area either.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RoadKinds_t:
Separate with semicolons: main = main roads, street = streets and parking lots, gravel = gravel ground, sidewalk = sidewalks and plazas. Empty = main;street.
Within a few tiles of a home only main roads count, so players can enclose their own driveway.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_AvoidResour:
A safehouse area cannot include resource buildings (police stations, hospitals and so on).
Needs Minidoracat MiniMap; without it, this is not checked.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_ResourceRul:
MiniMap resources: matches the resource icons on the minimap.
Room data: a building counts if any room in it belongs to a chosen category. Also covers map mods; stricter.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_ResourceCat:
Separate with semicolons. Category names are the same as in the minimap: military, police, gunstore, medical, pharmacy, fire, books, school, grocery, gas, tools, outdoor, prison, storage, electronics, church, farm, industry, retail, food.
Empty = military;police;gunstore;medical;pharmacy;fire;gas;prison (military, police, gun stores, medical, pharmacies, fire stations, gas stations, prisons).
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_TiersEnable: How many deed tiers are enabled, counting from tier 1. Deeds of disabled tiers cannot be used, do not drop and cannot be crafted. Deeds players already hold are kept and work again if the tier is enabled again. Safehouses already built stay protected; rented slots can still be renewed in the Slots window, but no new ones can be bought.

Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1Area_t: Largest area of a safehouse created with a tier 1 deed, in tiles. It never exceeds the outline limit squared.

Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1FreeSl:
How many tier 1 safehouses each player can build for free.
Admins can change the tier 1 number for one player on the admin panel's Players tab.
Lowering it keeps existing safehouses protected; it only blocks new ones.

How many tier 1 slots each player can buy permanently in the Economy Center (needs Minidoracat Economy).
0 = not sold. Lowering it keeps slots already bought; it only blocks new purchases.

0 = not rented. Lowering it keeps current leases and their renewals; it only blocks new rentals.

Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_DeedLoot_to:
When on, deeds can appear when an office desk, filing cabinet or safe generates its items for the first time, using each tier's drop chance.
When off, no tier drops.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1LootCh:
Chance that a tier 1 deed appears when an office desk, filing cabinet or safe generates its items for the first time.
0 = never drops.
Needs "Deeds drop as loot" turned on.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1Craft_: Which recipe makes tier 1 deeds: Disabled, Easy, Standard or Strict.
